tema: blend defines a mold; refill makes a new one; cup means “this very one”.

charla.texto: Junior level. First lesson: classes. A class is a mold for making identical objects. In Coffee it's written blend.
To make a new one from the mold you use refill. And inside the class, cup means “this object”, the one being used.
Like the forge: the mold is the class, every sword that comes out is an object. And cup is… the sword in your hand.
Rikka, you should be teaching. You explained it better than the documentation.
blend Empleado: a class with lots of methods and no rights. and you instantiate it with refill. like office coffee: until whoever pays runs out
Prof, if I make a Rikka class, does the constructor have to reserve extra memory for her butt?
If you make a Cami class, the constructor has to reserve extra memory for her mouth.
codigo: // 1. Inside the class, «this object» is cup.
// 3. Call the method that adds hours.

lineas: // Junior · Lesson 1: classes. Fill in the blanks.
pour cup.nombre + ' has worked ' + cup.horas + ' hours (unpaid)';
// Expected output: Jair has worked 60 hours (unpaid)
blend Name { ... }              -> defines a class (in JavaScript: class).
sip constructor(x) { ... }      -> runs when the object is created.
refill Name(...)                -> creates a new object (in JavaScript: new).
(Spanish names in the code: Empleado = Employee, trabajar = work, horas = hours.)
This is what GENESIS code uses. If you ever see weird code written in a weird place, it'll be this.

1.error: “{valor}” isn't “this object”. Inside the class, the current object is cup.

2.error: “{valor}” doesn't create a new object. To use the mold you write refill Empleado(...).

3.error: Empleado has no “{valor}()”. Look at the class methods: the one that adds hours is trabajar.

exito: ✔ Compiled. First object created. It's already working. It didn't ask for anything.

Rikka: Inside the mold, the sword is called cup. Well, the object.
The method that adds hours is trabajar. The others don't exist at this company.

al_abrir.texto: Three blanks: cup inside the constructor, refill to create the object and the method that adds hours.
A mold that manufactures employees… This is darker than my kingdom's magic.

al_resolver.texto: Sixty hours unpaid. It compiles. Just because something compiles doesn't mean it's right.
The mold worked! Now I can forge as many employees as I want.

cierre.texto: Classes: the mold for almost everything you'll program from now on.
and the first thing we made with the mold was an employee who works for free. very educational. very realistic
and cami: not every constructor is an invitation. sometimes it's just a constructor
